dct_creator_sm: Oudes, Dirk (Wageningen University and Research). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4469-0966
dct_description_sm: Only quantitative Q-sort analytical results are shared. Qualitative interviews were also part of this methodology but are not being shared.

Q-methodology surveys were completed in three Nova Scotia municipalities to understand the discourses around large-scale solar installation in everyday rural landscapes. We are unable due to ethics clearances to share the raw data, but provide the raw analytical output.
dct_title_s: Using Q-method to understand how to incorporate large-scale solar in rural Nova Scotia, Canada
